title: YouTube Transcript Pro input
description: Get transcripts, subtitles and captions from YouTube videos, channels, playlists and search.

urls.title: YouTube URLs
urls.description: Videos (watch, youtu.be, Shorts, embed, live, m./music.youtube.com), channels (@handle, /channel/UC…, /c/…, /user/…), playlists, or plain 11-character video IDs. Channels and playlists are expanded into their videos.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Find videos by YouTube search, e.g. "claude ai tutorial". Each query is treated like a channel: up to "Max videos per channel / playlist / search" videos.

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per channel / playlist / search
maxVideosPerSource.description: How many videos to take from each channel, playlist or search query (newest first for channels).

channelTab.title: Channel tab
channelTab.description: Which channel tab to read. A tab in the URL (e.g. /@name/shorts) overrides this.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Caption languages in order of preference, as codes: en, hi, es, fr, de, ja, pt-BR… "en" also matches en-US / en-GB.

fallbackToAnyLanguage.title: Fall back to any language
fallbackToAnyLanguage.description: If none of your languages exist, take the video's own caption track instead of skipping it.

preferManualCaptions.title: Prefer human-made captions
preferManualCaptions.description: Use creator-uploaded captions over YouTube's auto-generated ones when both exist in the chosen language.

allLanguages.title: Download every available language
allLanguages.description: One result per caption track (each language, manual and auto). Each is charged as a transcript.

translateTo.title: Translate to
translateTo.description: Optional language code (e.g. hi, en, es). Adds transcript_translated using YouTube's own caption translation, or Google Translate line by line when YouTube refuses. Leave empty for no translation.

includeSrt.title: SRT subtitles
includeSrt.description: Add a ready-to-use .srt subtitle file as text.

includeVtt.title: WebVTT subtitles
includeVtt.description: Add a ready-to-use .vtt subtitle file as text.

includeSegments.title: Timestamped segments
includeSegments.description: Add "data" (text, start, dur for every line) and "lines".

includeTimestampedText.title: Text with timestamps
includeTimestampedText.description: Add transcript_timestamped: one line per caption with [m:ss] in front — easy to read and to cite.

includeParagraphs.title: Paragraphs
includeParagraphs.description: Add the transcript as readable paragraphs (split on pauses), each with its start time.

chunkWords.title: LLM / RAG chunk size (words)
chunkWords.description: Split the transcript into chunks of about this many words, each with start/end time and a link to that moment in the video. 0 = off. 200–500 suits most RAG setups.

chunkOverlapWords.title: Chunk overlap (words)
chunkOverlapWords.description: Words repeated between neighbouring chunks, for better retrieval. 0 = no overlap.

includeChapters.title: Chapters
includeChapters.description: When the description lists chapters (0:00 Intro …), add each chapter with its own transcript text and link.

transcriptKeywords.title: Find keywords in transcripts
transcriptKeywords.description: Every moment these words or phrases are said, with the line, context and a link to that second of the video.

extraMetadata.title: Extra metadata (category, publish date, likes)
extraMetadata.description: One small extra request per video for category, exact publish date and like count.

publishedAfter.title: Only videos published after
publishedAfter.description: A date (2025-01-31) or a period ("30 days", "6 months"). Uses the exact publish date.

minDurationSeconds.title: Min duration (seconds)
minDurationSeconds.description: Skip videos shorter than this. 0 = off.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Max duration (seconds)
maxDurationSeconds.description: Skip videos longer than this. 0 = off.

aiProvider.title: AI transcription for videos without captions
aiProvider.sectionCaption: AI transcription (optional, your own API key)
aiProvider.description: When a video has no captions, download its audio and transcribe it with your own API key. You pay the AI provider directly (Groq ≈ $0.04 / audio hour, OpenAI ≈ $0.36 / audio hour).

aiApiKey.title: AI provider API key
aiApiKey.description: Your Groq or OpenAI API key. Stored encrypted by Apify and only sent to the provider you chose.

aiMaxMinutes.title: Max video length for AI (minutes)
aiMaxMinutes.description: Longer caption-less videos are skipped (and not charged). Audio files above 25 MB are skipped too.

maxResults.title: Max transcripts in total
maxResults.description: Stop after this many saved (and charged) transcripts. 0 = no limit.

includeFailedVideos.title: Show videos without a transcript
includeFailedVideos.description: Adds a free row (status = no_captions / unavailable / age_restricted / blocked / invalid_input …) with the reason and how to fix it.

skipPreviouslyScraped.title: Skip videos saved in previous runs
skipPreviouslyScraped.description: Remembers saved video + language pairs in a named key-value store — ideal for scheduled channel monitoring.

dedupeStoreName.title: Memory store name
dedupeStoreName.description: Key-value store used by "Skip videos saved in previous runs". Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

proxyFallback.title: Automatic proxy fallback
proxyFallback.description: If YouTube keeps bot-checking the chosen proxy, switch automatically to Apify residential, then datacenter proxy, then the server IP.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: YouTube bot-checks server IPs. Residential works best and costs about $0.0002 per video (≈25 KB per video).
